subject: Re: Annual reserved token program — Starter / Growth / Enterprise options
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Jones <alex.jones@greenfieldhealth.com>, procurement@greenfieldhealth.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Annual reserved token program inquiry

Hi Diego,

Thanks for the demo last week — the latency numbers look promising for our triage workflows. Before we move to an internal evaluation, procurement asked me to get written options for an annual reserved token program (per-token usage, annualized).

Specifically we want:
- A clear table with Starter / Growth / Enterprise tiers (annual reserved token volumes, effective per-token price, standard overage rate).
- Ramp / run-rate assumptions for the first 90 days (we expect a 3x growth from pilot to steady state).
- Any upfront credits, onboarding discounts, or credits for usage smoothing.

Can you send a short overview + price matrix we can include in the SOW? Also confirm whether SOC 2 evidence and custom data-retention terms are available for enterprise.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Park
Head of Product, Greenfield Health
emily.park@greenfieldhealth.com

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual reserved token program inquiry

Hi Emily — appreciate the detail. Per your ask I'm attaching a compact pricing workbook and a one-page overview of our annual reserved token program. High level below so procurement has something to circulate quickly.

Starter (annual reserved): 50M tokens/year — list price $0.0012/token — effective discounted price $0.00096/token (20% off)
Growth (annual reserved): 250M tokens/year — list price $0.0010/token — effective price $0.00070/token (30% off)
Enterprise (annual reserved): 1B tokens/year — list price $0.0009/token — effective price $0.00054/token (40% off)

Overages: billed monthly at 110% of the effective per-token price for the tier (to discourage frequent overages); we provide automatic scaling allowances for the first 30 days of ramp.

Ramp profile suggestion: 0–30 days pilot (10% of annual monthly run rate), 31–90 days ramp to 60% of steady monthly allocation, thereafter steady-state. We can structure a staged billing schedule and apply smoothing credits if you provide monthly forecast windows.

Enterprise entitlements: custom data-retention, VPC/private deployment options, and SOC 2 Type II artifacts are available under NDA — our security team will provide the package.

Attaching: 2027-03-22_Greenfield_Tiered_Pricing.xlsx (spreadsheet) and redwood-annual-reserve-terms-2027.docx (docx)

Short next steps:
1) Review the workbook and confirm preferred tier and expected start date.
2) If Enterprise, we'll send the NDA/Security packet and an MSA addendum for custom retention.
3) If procurement wants, Marissa can follow with a commercial term sheet and DocuSign.

Happy to jump on a 20-minute call later this week to walk the numbers.

Best,
Diego Fernandez

Subject: Re: Annual reserved token program inquiry — proposed commercial tweaks

Emily — looping in Laura from Sales Ops so procurement can see approval path. Diego and I discussed a commercial structure that typically works well for health-tech customers with bursty early usage. Proposed adjustments to the workbook above: 

- Starter: keep listed volume but add a one-time onboarding credit equal to 5% of the annual commitment (applied against the first invoice).
- Growth: introduce a quarterly true-up with a 90-day notice window for moving to a higher tier; include a 2% additional discount for a 24-month committed term.
- Enterprise: maintain the 40% effective discount but offer an additional 1-month free on annual prepay + waived setup fee for signed MSA within 30 days.

Procurement asks we often see: custom SLA terms (latency percentile commitments), data-retention specifics, and PO/billing cadence. We can accept a quarterly billing cadence for Growth and Enterprise where PO timing requires it.

If procurement needs a revised commercial term sheet, I can produce a tracked-change version of the SOW for review.

Thanks — happy to align on wording for the SOW or routing an initial DocuSign.

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Annual reserved token program inquiry — procurement counter

Marissa / Diego — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few procurement items so we can get this into our legal and finance review: 

1) Discount floors: our finance team would like the following as minimum effective per-token prices after any credits: Starter >= $0.00095, Growth >= $0.00068, Enterprise >= $0.00053. Can you confirm you can accept those floors?
2) Overage mechanics: we prefer a capped overage multiplier (max 125% of list price) rather than dynamic monthly multipliers.
3) Termination for convenience: we need a 90-day termination at the enterprise tier with pro-rated refund on unused tokens for prepaid plans.

Also please share SOC 2 Type II evidence and a redacted copy of the MSA. If those items look good we can move to PO/DocuSign quickly.

Thanks,
Alex Jones
Head of Platform Engineering, Greenfield Health
alex.jones@greenfieldhealth.com

Alex / Emily / team — thanks for the clear counter. I reviewed internally with Revenue Ops and Legal; summary of what's approved today: 

- Effective per-token floors: Starter $0.00095 (approved), Growth $0.00068 (approved), Enterprise $0.00053 (approved).
- Overage: we will cap overages at 125% of list price (matches your ask).
- Termination: for Enterprise annual prepay we can accept a 90-day termination-for-convenience with pro-rated refund on unused prepaid tokens subject to an administrative processing fee (1% of remaining value). Legal will reflect that in the MSA redline.
- Security pack: SOC 2 Type II artifacts and our standard security addendum will be shared under NDA by EOD tomorrow.

Commercial sweeteners: we will apply a one-time onboarding credit equal to 5% of the first-year invoice for Starter and a waived setup fee for Enterprise if MSA signed within 30 days.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Diego to send a tracked commercial term sheet with the approved floors and cap.
2) Marissa to open DocuSign with the SOW + MSA redline (legal will attach security addendum).
3) Greenfield procurement to confirm PO cadence (monthly vs quarterly) so billing ops can set invoicing.

Diego and Marissa — happy to join a quick sync if Greenfield wants to walk the updated term sheet.
